verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le Aw ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.sm: Ina fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu, A agasala se tasi ma le sese i se tasi poloaiga a le ALI i mea e le tusa ona faia, ma na faia se tasi o ia mea.

verses.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.sm: Afai e agasala le faitaulaga ua faauuina, e sese ai le nuu, na te avatu ai i le ALII se povi poa taanoa e sao ona lelei e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala, ona o lana agasala na ia agasala ai.

verses.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.sm: Na te aumaia foi le povi poa taanoa i le faitotoa O le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i luma o le ALII; na te faaec foi lona lima i le ulu o le povi poa taanoa, ma fasi ai le povi poa taanoa i luma o le Aw.

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e le faitaulaga ua faauuina nisi toto o le povi poa taanoa, ma avatu aji le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga;

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.sm: ona fufui ai lea e le faitaulaga lona tamatamai lima i le toto, ma sausau faafitu nisi o le toto i luma o le ALII, i luma o le ie puipui o le mea paia.

verses.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: E tuu ai foi e le faitaulaga nisi O le toto i nifo o le fata e mu ai mea manogi lelei i luma o le ALII, ua i ai lea i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga; a o le toto uma o le povi na te liligi ai i lalo ifo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, ua i ai lea i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.sm: Na te aveeseina ai foi ga‘o uma o le povi poa taanoa o le taulaga mo le agasala, o le ga'o alo ma ga'o uma ua i ai.

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.sm: O fatugaʻo foi e lua, ma gaʻo o i ai, ua i lāgotua, ma le gaʻo punipū ua i luga o le finagalo, ma fatuga'o, na te aveeseina ia,

verses.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.sm: JO E pei ona aveeseina e ia i le povi o le taulaga faafetai; e susunuina ia e le faitaulaga i luga o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu.

verses.en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.sm: A ole pa’uo le povi poa taanoa, ma ona anogase uma, ma lona ulu, ma ona alaga, ma ona totoga, ma ona otaota,

verses.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.sm: na te avea le povi poa taanoa uma lava i tua o le toagālauapi, i se mea mamā, o le mea e sasaa ai le lefulefu, ma ia susunuina ai i luga o fafie i le afi; o le mea e sasaaina ai le lefulefu e susunuina ai ia.

verses.en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.sm: Afai e sese le faapotopotoga uma O Isaraelu, ma ua lilo le mea i le faapotopotoga, ma ua latou faia se mea E le tusa ma se poloaiga a le ALTI i mea uma e le tusa ona fai, ma ua nofo sala i latou;

verses.en: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: pe a iloa le agasala na latou agasala ai, ona avatu ai lea e le faapotopotoga se povi poa taanoa e fai ma taulaga ona o le agasala; latou te au maiaii luma o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.sm: O toeaina foi o le faapotopotoga, latou te faaee ai o latou lima i le ulu o le povi poa taanoa i luma o le ALII; e fasia foi le povi poa taanoa i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.sm: Ona au mai lea e le faitaulaga ua faauuina nisi o lc toto o le povi poa taanoa i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga;

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
verses.sm: ona fufui ai lea e le faitaulaga lona tamatamai lima i le toto, ma sausau faafitu ai i luma o le ALII, i luma o le ie puipui.

verses.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: Na te tuuina atu ai foi nisi o le toto i nifo o le fata faitaulaga ua i luma o le ALII, ua i ai lea i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga; a o le toto uma na te liligiina ifo i lalo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, ua i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
verses.sm: A o ona ga'o uma na te aveeseina ai, ma susunu i luga o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.sm: Na te faia foi i le povi poa taanoa, pei ona ia fai i le povi poa taanoa na fai ma taulaga mo le agasala, e faapea lava ona fai; ona fai ai lea e le faitaulaga le togiola mo i latou, ona faamagaloina ai lea o i latou.

verses.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.sm: Na te avatua le povi poa taanoa i tua o le toagalauapi, ma susunu ai e pei ona ia susunu le uluai povi poa taanoa; o le taulaga mo le agasala lea mo le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.sm: A agasala se alii, ma na faia ma le sese se mea e le tusa ma se tasi poloaiga a le ALII lona Atua i mea ua le tusa ona fai, ma ua nofo sala ai o ia.

verses.en: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.sm: A iloa foi e ia lana agasala ua ia agasala ai, na te au mai ai lana taulaga, o se 'oti poa e sao ona lelei.

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
verses.sm: Na te faaee foi lona lima i le ulu o le “oti poa, ma fasi ai i le mea e fasi ai le taulaga mu i luma o le ALII; o le taulaga mo le agasala lea.

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e le faitaulaga nisi o le toto o le taulaga mo le agasala i lona tamatamai lima, ma tuu ai i nifo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, na te liligiina ifo foi le toto i lalo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu.

verses.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.sm: A o ona ga'o uma na te susunuina i le fata faitaulaga, e pei o pao o le taulaga faafetai; ona fai ai lea e le faitaulaga se togiola mo ia ona o lana agasala, ona faamagaloina ai lea o ia.

verses.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.sm: A e afai e agasala ma le sese se tagata o le nuu, ma ua faia se mea e le tusa ma se tesi poloaiga a le ALII i mea ua le tusa ona fai, ma ua nofo sala o ia;

verses.en: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.sm: a iloa foi e ia lana agasala ua ia agasala ai; ona au mai ai lea e ia o lana taulaga, o se ‘oti fafine e sao ona lelei, ona o lana agasala ua ia agasala ai.

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.sm: Na te faaee foi lona lima i le ulu o le taulaga mo le agasala, ma fasi le taulaga mo le agasala i le mea e fai ai le taulaga mu.

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e le faitaulaga nisi o lona toto i lona tamatamai lima, ma tuu ai i nifo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu; a o lona toto uma na te liligiina ifo i lalo o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.sm: Na te aveeseina foi ona ga'o uma, e pei ona aveeseina ga'o o le taulaga faafetai; ona susunuina ai lea e le faitaulaga i le fata faitaulaga, o le mea manogi lelei lea i le ALII; e faia foi e le faitaulaga se togiola mo ia, ona faamagaloina ai lea o ia.

verses.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.sm: Afai foi na te au mai se tamai mamoe mana taulaga e fai ma tau~ laga mo le agasala, na te au mai se manu fafine c sao ona lelei.

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.sm: Na te faaee foi lona lima i le ulu o le taulaga mo le agasala, ma fasi ai, e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala, i le mea e fasi ai le taulaga mu.

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e le faitaulaga nisi O le toto o le taulaga mo le agasala i lona tamatamai lima, ma tuu ai i nifo o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu; a o lona toto uma na te liligiina ifo i lalo o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.sm: A 0 ona ga'o uma na te aveeseina, e pei ona aveeseina ga‘o o le tamai mamoe o le taulaga faafetai; ona susunuina ai lea e le faitaulaga i le fata faitaulaga, e pei o taulaga e fai i le afi ile ALII; e faia foi e le faitaulaga se togiola mo ia ona o lana agasala ua ia agasala ai, ona faamagaloina ai lea o ia.
